answer: The brewhouse steams in the morning, malt sacks stacked by the mash tun. Proof of brewer via malt ale tally — a barrel the brewer brews only after 33 barrels hold their brew without one souring at the cask, each brewed by the brewer himself. delta mashes the malt and runs the wort off clear. violet boils the wort with hops and cools it in the trough. beacon pitches the yeast and racks the ale into casks. Thirty-three barrels must hold their brew without one souring at the cask, and the next still sours where the wort ran cloudy.
